Definitions

Prediction sets. A conformal set can be {0}, {1}, {0,1} or empty. Since E[|C|] = 1 - P(empty) + P(both) the mean size does not identify the composition, so the three rates are reported separately.
Operational subset. Backward local maxima are events with no larger predecessor inside the labelling window. Within that subset a negative label means the event was followed by something larger, which is the operational question.
ETAS null. Offspring magnitudes are drawn independently of their parents, so no event-role information exists in a simulated catalog. The fitted parameters, the implied branching ratio and the calibration status of each null are in the ETAS parameter table.

Figures

grid_auc

Test AUC across the labelling grid

grid_f1

Test F1 across the labelling grid

grid_flip_rate_vs_ref

Fraction of labels that change class against the reference window

grid_rate_empty

Empty prediction sets at alpha = 0.10

auc_vs_f1_divergence

Ranking skill and thresholded utility respond differently to a change in the labelling window.

reliability

Calibration before and after recalibration.

aci_coverage

Fixed-threshold and adaptive conformal coverage through time.

set_composition

An empty set excludes both classes and has coverage zero by construction; a two-class set is an abstention.

etas_null_floor

Pooled AUC on real catalogs and on simulated catalogs where no event-role physics exists by construction.

shap_stability

How far the explanation moves when only the label moves.

cost_model

Expected cost against the conformal risk level.

counts_and_mc

Event counts and the magnitude of completeness are distinct quantities and are plotted separately.

transfer

Discrimination, marginal coverage and the class-conditional coverage gap for each donor-target pair.

decision_rule_empty_set

Effect of routing empty prediction sets to ESCALATE at alpha = 0.1. The rules coincide wherever the empty-set rate is zero.
